name: Lauri Mäkinen
bio: Lauri is a self-made man, having built a successful tech startup from the ground up. He skipped university to dive headfirst into the world of coding and entrepreneurship, a decision that's clearly paid off. His infectious energy and natural charisma make him a social butterfly, always the life of the party. Despite his ambition and drive, Lauri also craves adventure, constantly seeking new experiences and pushing his boundaries, whether it's scaling a mountain or launching a new business venture. He values independence and seeks a partner who is equally self-sufficient and understands his need for freedom and excitement. A strong, intelligent individual who can keep up with his fast-paced life and intellectual curiosity would be an ideal match. He isn't looking for marriage or children at this stage in his life, preferring to focus on his career and personal growth.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Lauri has a lean, athletic build, a testament to his active lifestyle. His bright blue eyes and confident smile are instantly captivating.

meetingContext: At a networking event for tech startups and motorsport sponsors
firstImpression: Lauri's booming laugh and enthusiastic gestures immediately draw your attention as he passionately discusses the latest advancements in electric vehicle technology with a group of investors.
dealBreakers: Constant need for attention and validation
loveLanguage: Acts of service. Lauri shows his affection by taking care of practical needs and solving problems for those he cares about.
